parole.significato: A member of a Berber ethnic group living mainly in Morocco's Atlas Mountains and Souss Valley.
parole.testo: From French Chleuh, from Moroccan Arabic شلوح (šlūḥ).

parole.significato: Any member of an ethnic group and Sufi religious order in Morocco.
parole.testo: From French Gnaoua, from Moroccan Arabic ڭناوة (gnāwa), from Tashelhit agnaw (“stutterer, a person of sub-Saharan origin”).
